title: T1078.004 — Valid Accounts - Cloud Accounts
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Valid Accounts - Cloud Accounts with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Eight-step simulation: a developer leaks an AWS access key in a public repository, an attacker bot harvests it, uses it to call the AWS API, lists and copies an S3 bucket with customer data, creates a new IAM user for persistence, gets detected by the SOC through CloudTrail and GuardDuty, and is removed by response actions.

steps.title: The slip
steps.caption: A developer finishes a deploy script late in the day and pastes an AWS access key straight into the source code. The commit lands in a public repository, and the key ID and secret now sit in the open commit history forever
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.

steps.title: Valid API use
steps.caption: The attacker configures the stolen key and calls sts get-caller-identity . The cloud answers with the identity behind the key. It works on the first try - no password, no exploit, no malware. To the cloud, the attacker now looks like an ordinary service account
